notice: If you don’t sign in, your resume is stored in this browser only. When you download a PDF, the content is sent to our server just to create the file and is not kept.
noticeLink: Sign in to keep your resume safe in your account
employerSharing: If you sign in and give your consent, we can share your resume with companies that are hiring and help you land a job more easily. Consent is entirely optional, and you can withdraw it at any time.
dataUse: When you sign in, your resume is saved to your account: reach it from any device and never lose your edits. Your data travels over an encrypted connection and is visible only to you and the employers you consent to. We never sell your data.
guestNoData: If you don’t sign in, nothing is sent to us or stored.
signUpConsent: I agree that my resume may be shared with companies that are hiring. (Optional; I can withdraw at any time.)
signUpDataNote: Your account data (your email and resumes) is kept only to store your resumes and show them to you. Without your consent it is shared with no one.
cardDescription: Turn this on to add your resume to a candidate pool that can be shared with hiring companies. Employer matching launches soon; only candidates who consent will be included.
cardOn: Consent given — your resume is in the candidate pool.
cardOff: No consent — your resume is shared with no one.
withdrawNote: You can turn this off any time; your resume is removed from the pool immediately.
error: Couldn’t save your preference. Please try again.
noticeShort: Your resume is stored only in this browser.
